{{Quote|I'll meet you at our secret base in Sector Four.|Grievous, to the crew of the ''Malevolence''|<ref name="Destroy Malevolence">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref>}}
'''Sector Four''' was an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] occupied by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the war, the Confederacy built a [[Sector Four Confederacy base/Legends|secret base]] there. The Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] planned to retreat and meet his [[Warship/Legends|warship]], the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], at the base, but the warship was [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|destroyed]] before it could reach the base.
